meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 给选定的 NanoClaw agent 组装上免密钥的 Tavily 远程 MCP 工具,组内 agent 会多出 tavily_search 和 tavily_extract 两个工具,用来做网页搜索和 URL 内容提取。
howto.when: 当你要在不使用 API key 的情况下安装 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取时使用。

say.text: 跑一次 Tavily 搜索,max_results 设为 1,报告是否成功
say.note: 用来验证工具装通了没有

say.text: Tavily 返回 429 了,按升级流程换成付费 API key
say.note: agent 会给出预填好的 OneCLI 链接

howto.what_en: Installs keyless Tavily remote MCP tools into selected NanoClaw agent groups: agents gain tavily_search and tavily_extract for web search and URL extraction; Crawl, Map and Research are filtered out.
howto.when_en: Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

say_en.text: Add keyless Tavily search and extract to agent group <group-id>
say_en.note: Registers the tavily MCP server and restarts the group

say_en.text: Run one Tavily search with max_results 1 and report whether it succeeds
Tavily returned 429 - walk me through the paid API key upgrade
say_en.note: Agent offers the prefilled OneCLI link
